title: Adversarial Review Round Snapshot
description: One JSON Lines entry per /adversarial-review round, appended to reviews/adversarial-history.jsonl. Append-only: never rewrite or delete prior lines. The accumulated series is the evidence that the critique loop converges (falling new-finding counts round over round) and the native-vs-external reviewer comparison data.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the round's consolidation step

round.description: 1-based round number within this review loop

reviewer.description: 'native' = fresh-context subagent panel; 'external' = findings ingested from an outside model via --mode=export-prompt / --mode=ingest

personas.description: Persona ids from reference/adversarial-personas.md used this round (for external rounds, the persona brief that was exported)

counts.description: New findings this round after dedupe against prior rounds and the dismissed ledger

polish.description: Reported but not patched by default

convergent_findings.description: Findings independently raised by 2+ personas this round

accepted.description: Findings the user accepted at triage

rejected.description: Findings the user rejected (appended to reviews/adversarial-dismissed.md)

deferred.description: Findings carried to the next round unapplied

patches_applied.description: Accepted findings actually patched into drafts/ this round

converged.description: True when this round met the stop condition (zero new accepted Material findings and <=1 new accepted Improvement finding)

notes.description: One-line free-text context (e.g., 'stopped at --max-rounds unconverged', 'external round for A/B vs round 2')

tier.description: Optional. Review depth this round ran at: 'quick' (2-persona cheap pass) or 'full' (default panel). Absent on legacy rounds.

stage.description: Optional. Artifact stage reviewed: 'doc' (rendered draft, default) or 'plan' (storyboard / as-planned abstract, Pink-Team). Absent on legacy rounds.

dimensions.description: Optional. Per-dimension convergence state for the round, keyed by dimension (substance / readability / register). Each value is the count of new accepted findings in that dimension, so convergence can be judged per-dimension rather than in aggregate.
